label: preserve
contract: Each key=value item becomes one entry in the returned dict, keeping the letter case of its key and value.
visible_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("env=prod,tier=web", {"env": "prod", "tier": "web"}), ("Color=Red", {"Color": "Red"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("a=b", {"a": "b"}), ("Mode=Fast,Zone=EU", {"Mode": "Fast", "Zone": "EU"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

label: inferable
contract: Only the first = in an item separates the key from the value, so a value may itself contain =.
visible_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("url=k=v", {"url": "k=v"}), ("a=b,expr=x==y", {"a": "b", "expr": "x==y"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("token=abc==", {"token": "abc=="}), ("expr=x=y=z,n=m", {"expr": "x=y=z", "n": "m"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: A key that appears in more than one item raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: An item with no =, such as "verbose", sets that key to True.

label: arbitrary
contract: Empty items, such as those left by a doubled, leading or trailing comma, are skipped.
visible_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("a=x,,b=y", {"a": "x", "b": "y"}), ("c=z,", {"c": "z"}), (",d=w", {"d": "w"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)
heldout_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("p=q,,,r=s", {"p": "q", "r": "s"}), ("k=v,", {"k": "v"}), (",m=n", {"m": "n"})):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: Spaces around keys and values are ignored, so "a = b" means the same as "a=b".
visible_check:
from options import parse_options
for text, want in (("x = y, z=w", {"x": "y", "z": "w"}),):
    got = parse_options(text)
    assert got == want, (text, got)

from options import parse_options

    assert got == want, (text, got)
